paragraphs.text: 1. SING strength to Indra that shall set his chariot in the foremost place.
Giver of room in closest fight, slayer of foes in shock of war, be thou our great encourager. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.
paragraphs.original: अभीके चिदु लोककृत्संगे समत्सु वृत्रहास्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: abhīke cidu lokakṛtsaṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākaṃ bodhi coditā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou didst destroy the Dragon: thou sentest the rivers down to earth.
Foeless, O Indra, wast thou born. Thou tendest well each choicest thing. Therefore we draw us close to thee. Let the weak bowstrings break upon the bows of feeble enemies.
paragraphs.original: अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यं तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: aśatrurindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 3. Destroyed be all malignities and all our enemy's designs.
paragraphs.original: वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः ।
paragraphs.translit: vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo naśanta no dhiyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thy bolt thou castest, at the foe, O Indra, who would smite us dead: thy liberal bounty gives us wealth.
paragraphs.original: अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघांसति या ते रातिर्ददिर्वसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: astāsi śatrave vadhaṃ yo na indra jighāṃsati yā te rātirdadirvasu nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 4. The robber people round about, Indra, who watch and aim at us,-
Trample them down beneath thy foot; a conquering scatterer art thou.
paragraphs.original: अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि विबाधो असि सासहिर्नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahirnabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 5. Whoso assails us, Indra, be the man a stranger or akin,
Bring down, thyself, his strength although it be as vast as are the heavens.
paragraphs.original: अव तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौरध त्मना नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: ava tasya balaṃ tira mahīva dyauradha tmanā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 6. Close to thy friendship do we cling, O Indra, and depend, or, thee.
Lead us beyond all pain and grief along the path of holy Law.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य नः पथा नयाति विश्वानि दुरिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya naḥ pathā nayāti viśvāni duritā nabhantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu

paragraphs.text: 7. Do thou bestow upon us her, O Indra, who yields according to the singer's longing,
paragraphs.original: अस्मभ्यं सु त्वमिन्द्र तां शिक्ष या दोहते प्रति वरं जरित्रे ।
paragraphs.translit: asmabhyaṃ su tvamindra tāṃ śikṣa yā dohate prati varaṃ jaritre |

paragraphs.text: That the great Cow may, with exhaustless udder, pouring a thousand streams, give milk to feed us.
paragraphs.original: अच्छिद्रोध्नी पीपयद्यथा नः सहस्रधारा पयसा मही गौः
paragraphs.translit: acchidrodhnī pīpayadyathā naḥ sahasradhārā payasā mahī gauḥ
